rules.title: Container runs as root
rules.why: Without a USER instruction the process runs as root; a container escape or a file write bug is then much worse.
rules.fix: Create a user and switch to it with USER.

rules.title: ADD downloads from a URL
rules.why: ADD of a remote URL fetches content with no checksum verification.
rules.fix: Use curl/wget with a checksum check in a RUN step.

rules.title: Base image without a version
rules.why: FROM image or :latest changes under you and can break or compromise builds.
rules.fix: Pin a version (and ideally a digest).

rules.title: Downloaded script piped to a shell
rules.why: Running a script straight from the network executes whatever the server returns.
rules.fix: Download, verify a checksum or signature, then run.
